cues.en: In the last lecture.
cues.zh: 上一堂。

cues.en: We worked on this route.
cues.zh: 我們完成了這條路由。

cues.en: Now let's add it to our main.py file.
cues.zh: 現在把它加入 main.py。

cues.en: So going to open Main.py file within backend app API.
cues.zh: 開啟 backend/app/api 裡的 main.py。

cues.en: Then as usual at the top we have to import it.
cues.zh: 一樣先在上面匯入。

cues.en: And so right there after the create next of kin import we're going to import the all route like that.
cues.zh: 在 create_next_of_kin 匯入後面，加入 all 路由。

cues.en: Then scroll to the bottom duplicate that, then change create next of kin to all dot router like that.
cues.zh: 捲到下面複製這一行，將 create_next_of_kin 改成 all.router。

cues.en: Then what you're going to do next we're going to go back to postman.
cues.zh: 接著回到 Postman。

cues.en: Then if you are logged out please log in.
cues.zh: 如果已登出，請先登入。

cues.en: Or if you are refresh JWT is still valid.
cues.zh: 或是更新 JWT 仍有效。

cues.en: You can just refresh your tokens.
cues.zh: 就直接更新權杖。

cues.en: As you can see I'm now logged in.
cues.zh: 可以看到我現在已登入。

cues.en: Then we're going to make a Get request to http, api localhost, then slash api slash v1, then next of kin, then slash all make the request good.
cues.zh: 接著對 http://api.localhost/api/v1/next-of-kin/all 發送 GET 請求，很好。

cues.en: As you can see, we get all the next of kins belonging to the user, which are two next of kins, one being a primary and the other isn't a primary.
cues.zh: 取得這位使用者的所有近親資料，共兩位，一位是主要近親，另一位不是。

cues.en: Then one last thing that I forgot to mention previously in our lecture on creating next of kin.
cues.zh: 先前建立近親資料的課程，有一件事忘了說。

cues.en: Remember we had a limit.
cues.zh: 記得我們有人數上限。

cues.en: A user can only create up to a maximum of three next of kins.
cues.zh: 每位使用者最多只能建立 3 位近親。

cues.en: So if you can go to the create next of kin route, then let me see.
cues.zh: 到建立近親資料的路由，看看。

cues.en: Let me change its primary to false because you can only have one primary next of kin.
cues.zh: 將 is_primary 改為 False，因為只能有一位主要近親。

cues.en: And to try creating this next of kin again.
cues.zh: 再試著建立這位近親。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: It works because Mary Jane only had two next of kin.
cues.zh: 可以成功，因為 Mary Jane 原本只有兩位近親。

cues.en: If you go to the get or next of kin route, we now have three next of kin.
cues.zh: 到取得所有近親資料的路由，現在有 3 位了。

cues.en: So if I try creating another next of kin, the request is going to fail because we can only have a maximum of three next of kins.
cues.zh: 如果再建立另一位，請求就會失敗，因為最多只能有 3 位近親。

cues.en: So that functionality also works.
cues.zh: 這項功能也正常。

cues.en: So what you can do is we can commit our code in a git client.
cues.zh: 接著到 Git 用戶端提交程式碼。

cues.en: We can just say this is a feature and you can say user can get all their next of kin, then make the commit and that's it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這是 feature，訊息寫「使用者可以取得自己的所有近親資料」，接著提交，這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture we shall now work on the update next of kin schema.
cues.zh: 下一堂處理更新近親資料的 schema。
